definitions.explanation: An extremely low price; something being sold at a deep discount. A colloquial and emphatic term commonly seen in advertising and shopping contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{激安|げきやす}だ。
{激安|げきやす}⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought groceries at a bargain supermarket.

examples.japanese: ⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{激安|げきやす}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{航空券|こうくうけん}→航空券：19426_koukuuken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I found a super cheap airline ticket online and booked it right away.

notes:
USAGE:
A colloquial compound of {激|げき} (extreme) + ⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧ (cheap). Commonly used as a modifier before nouns: {激安|げきやす}＋noun. Frequently seen in advertising, store signage, and online shopping.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {激安|げきやす}⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧: bargain supermarket
- {激安|げきやす}⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧: rock-bottom sale
- {激安|げきやす}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: super-low price
- {激安|げきやす}⟦ショップ→ショップ：08913_shoppu⟧: discount shop

REGISTER:
Informal and commercial. Not used in formal writing.
